science.explanation: The Psychotronic Amplifier Array is a novel electronic device designed to amplify and manipulate psychotronic signals, which are believed to be a form of energy that can interact with living organisms.
assumptions: The existence of psychotronic signals as a real phenomenon
The ability to detect and measure psychotronic signals using electronic devices
